notes:
{成|な}り{立|た}つ describes something being composed of elements or being valid/functional.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (つ-verb)
- Intransitive

ETYMOLOGY:
- {成|な}る (to become) + ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand)

SENSE 1 VS SENSE 2:
- Sense 1: Composition (what something consists of)
- Sense 2: Validity/functionality (whether something works)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{成|な}り{立|た}つ (to consist of ~)
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{成|な}り{立|た}つ (~ is valid)
- {成|な}り{立|た}たない (doesn't hold, doesn't work)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{成|な}り{立|た}つ (theory holds)
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{成|な}り{立|た}つ (contract is valid)
- ⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{成|な}り{立|た}つ (business is viable)
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{成|な}り{立|た}たない (argument doesn't hold)

NEGATIVE FORM:
- {成|な}り{立|た}たない is very common
- Used to dismiss invalid arguments or unworkable situations

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{成|な}り{上|あ}がる→成り上がる：08205_nariagaru⟧ (to rise in status)
- ⟦{成|な}り{下|さ}がる→成り下がる：08235_narisagaru⟧ (to sink, become degraded)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be composed of - formal)
- ⟦{通用|つうよう}→通用：04530_tsuuyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be valid - more general)
- ⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to function)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in both spoken and written Japanese.
